verses.text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. Of David. Hear my cry, O God; attend to my prayer.

segments.text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. Of David. Hear my cry, O God; attend to my prayer.

verses.text: From the ends of the earth I call out to You whenever my heart is faint. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

segments.text: From the ends of the earth I call out to You whenever my heart is faint. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

verses.text: For You have been my refuge, a tower of strength against the enemy.

segments.text: For You have been my refuge, a tower of strength against the enemy.

verses.text: Let me dwell in Your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of Your wings. Selah

segments.text: Let me dwell in Your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of Your wings. Selah

verses.text: For You have heard my vows, O God; You have given me the inheritance reserved for those who fear Your name.

segments.text: For You have heard my vows, O God; You have given me the inheritance reserved for those who fear Your name.

verses.text: Increase the days of the king’s life; may his years span many generations.

segments.text: Increase the days of the king’s life; may his years span many generations.

verses.text: May he sit enthroned in God’s presence forever; appoint Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness to guard him.

segments.text: May he sit enthroned in God’s presence forever; appoint Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness to guard him.

verses.text: Then I will ever sing praise to Your name and fulfill my vows day by day.

segments.text: Then I will ever sing praise to Your name and fulfill my vows day by day.
